```lean
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Order.Bounds.Basic

open Nat

theorem rmo_2000_6 :
  (IsLeast {n | ∃ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 2000 ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 ∧ n = a * b} 10) ∧
  (IsLeast {n | ∃ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 2000 ∣ a ^ 3 * b ^ 4 ∧ n = a * b} 20) := by
  constructor
  · -- first part
    refine ⟨?mem1, ?min1⟩
    · -- 10 belongs to the set
      refine ⟨1, 10, ?_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
      · exact Nat.succ_pos 0
      · exact Nat.succ_pos 9
      · -- 2000 ∣ 1^2 * 10^5
        refine ⟨50, ?_⟩
        norm_num
    · -- 10 is minimal
      intro n hn
      rcases hn with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hdiv, rfl⟩
      -- from the divisibility we get 2 ∣ a*b and 5 ∣ a*b
      have h2 : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 :=
        dvd_trans (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ∣ 2000) hdiv
      have h5 : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 :=
        dvd_trans (by decide : (5 : ℕ) ∣ 2000) hdiv
      have h2ab : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        rcases (prime_two.dvd_mul).1 h2 with h2a | h2b
        · -- 2 ∣ a^2
          have h2a' : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a := prime_two.dvd_pow h2a
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h2a' b
        · -- 2 ∣ b^5
          have h2b' : (2 : ℕ) ∣ b := prime_two.dvd_pow h2b
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right a h2b'
      have h5ab : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        rcases (prime_five.dvd_mul).1 h5 with h5a | h5b
        · have h5a' : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a := prime_five.dvd_pow h5a
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h5a' b
        · have h5b' : (5 : ℕ) ∣ b := prime_five.dvd_pow h5b
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right a h5b'
      -- combine the two divisibilities to get 10 ∣ a*b
      rcases h2ab with ⟨c, hc⟩
      have h5c : (5 : ℕ) ∣ c := by
        have : (5 : ℕ) ∣ 2 * c := by
          simpa [hc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using h5ab
        have hcop : Nat.Coprime (5 : ℕ) 2 := by decide
        exact (hcop.dvd_mul_left).1 this
      rcases h5c with ⟨d, hd⟩
      have h10 : (10 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
        calc
          a * b = 2 * c := hc
          _ = 2 * (5 * d) := by simpa [hd]
          _ = (2 * 5) * d := by ring
          _ = 10 * d := rfl
      exact le_of_dvd (Nat.succ_pos _) h10
  · -- second part
    refine ⟨?mem2, ?min2⟩
    · -- 20 belongs to the set
      refine ⟨1, 20, ?_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
      · exact Nat.succ_pos 0
      · exact Nat.succ_pos 19
      · refine ⟨80, ?_⟩
        norm_num
    · -- 20 is minimal
      intro n hn
      rcases hn with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hdiv, rfl⟩
      have h2 : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 3 * b ^ 4 :=
        dvd_trans (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ∣ 2000) hdiv
      have h5 : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 3 * b ^ 4 :=
        dvd_trans (by decide : (5 : ℕ) ∣ 2000) hdiv
      have h2ab : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        rcases (prime_two.dvd_mul).1 h2 with h2a | h2b
        · have h2a' : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a := prime_two.dvd_pow h2a
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h2a' b
        · have h2b' : (2 : ℕ) ∣ b := prime_two.dvd_pow h2b
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right a h2b'
      have h5ab : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        rcases (prime_five.dvd_mul).1 h5 with h5a | h5b
        · have h5a' : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a := prime_five.dvd_pow h5a
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h5a' b
        · have h5b' : (5 : ℕ) ∣ b := prime_five.dvd_pow h5b
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right a h5b'
      rcases h2ab with ⟨c, hc⟩
      have h5c : (5 : ℕ) ∣ c := by
        have : (5 : ℕ) ∣ 2 * c := by
          simpa [hc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using h5ab
        have hcop : Nat.Coprime (5 : ℕ) 2 := by decide
        exact (hcop.dvd_mul_left).1 this
      rcases h5c with ⟨d, hd⟩
      have h10 : (10 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
        calc
          a * b = 2 * c := hc
          _ = 2 * (5 * d) := by simpa [hd]
          _ = (2 * 5) * d := by ring
          _ = 10 * d := rfl
      have h20 : (20 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        refine ⟨2 * d, ?_⟩
        calc
          a * b = 10 * d := h10
          _ = (2 * 5) * d := rfl
          _ = 20 * d /? sorry
      -- the above line can be simplified directly:
      have : a * b = 20 * d := by
        simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using h10
      exact le_of_dvd (Nat.succ_pos _) ⟨d, this⟩
```
